Optional arena debug notifications
=================================

cesta_region.h is ordinary C11 and needs neither Cesta nor a proof assistant.
With AddressSanitizer enabled it uses the compiler's sanitizer interface.
Without sanitizer instrumentation the notification macros are constant true
and do not evaluate their arguments. Real allocator state changes must remain
outside the notifications.

  CESTA_REGION_INITIALIZE(payload, capacity, live)
  CESTA_REGION_ACQUIRE(payload, capacity, old_live, new_live)
  CESTA_REGION_RESET(payload, capacity, old_live, new_live)
  CESTA_REGION_RELEASE(payload, capacity)

Initialize makes the live prefix addressable and poisons its suffix. Acquire
unpoisons the newly allocated interval before caller writes. Reset poisons the
released suffix while preserving the live prefix. Release poisons the payload
before the allocator publishes it for recycling or frees its real allocation.
Allocator links, counters and other retained metadata must be outside it.

Each notification returns false on invalid bounds, address overflow, a missing
nonempty backing, or boundaries that cannot cover complete ASan granules.
Refusal performs no shadow update. Empty null-backed regions succeed.
The caller supplies an actual allocation and serializes overlapping updates.
These are debug notifications, not a pointer-provenance or allocation-identity
checker. A reused, unpoisoned address can be reached by an old raw pointer;
native incarnation checks and static lifetime contracts remain separate.

CESTA_REGION_DEBUG may explicitly disable the adapter in a sanitizer build.
Enabling it requires a compatible AddressSanitizer runtime. It is never linked
into normal generated programs automatically.
